about: Built by tools/build_marble.py. The grounds come from OpenStreetMap; floors 1 and 2 are traced from Richard Morris Hunt’s 1889 plans of the house (Library of Congress). The rooms on floor 2 are named from the plan, so which bedroom is whose is approximate. The basement has no published plan: only its outline is drawn, and the places in it are approximate.
source: OpenStreetMap (grounds), Richard Morris Hunt’s first- and second-story plans, 1889 (Library of Congress), the Preservation Society of Newport County’s accessibility page (visitor facilities)
units: grounds: metres x 2.4, north up; house: pixels of the plans x 0.6 (the ocean side at the top)
